claire (DevEx): quick note from handoffs — sample-app onboarding keeps showing a vague error banner. digging in, SDKs are not surfacing structured error fields so UI can't show actionable help.

simon (SDK): example?

claire (DevEx): API response: 401 {"error":"unauthorized", "reason":"missing_scope", "hint":"token lacks scope:chat.write"}. Node client just throws Error('401') and we end up auto-refreshing tokens repeatedly.

ana (sample-app): result: refresh loop and bad UX. New users get stuck on first step.

simon (SDK): agreed we need a tiny cross-language error contract. proposal: each SDK error exposes: code (ERR_AUTH, ERR_PERM, ERR_QUOTA, ERR_RATE_LIMIT, ERR_VALIDATION, ERR_INTERNAL), status (int), message (string), hints (string[]), is_retryable (bool). keep names stable.

tom (infra): infra will start returning error.code and hints where available. fallback to mapping from HTTP status when not present. will add reason->ERR_QUOTA for quota_exceeded.

claire (DevEx): UX ask: quickstart should read err.hints[0] and show an inline hint instead of retrying. also cap refresh attempts.

simon (SDK): implementation notes: add typed Error subclasses (AuthError, RateLimitError, etc.) with those properties + a helper shouldRetry(err) that prefers is_retryable then falls back to status based rules (5xx/429 -> true, 4xx auth/perm/validation -> false).

marie (PM): +1, will add migration note. also add onboarding copy: if you see ERR_AUTH with scope hint, don't auto-refresh — check token scopes.

ci-bot: CI: sample-app tests failing on branch fix/error-shape — 2 failing (refresh-loop protection).

ana (sample-app): I'll patch quickstart to honor shouldRetry and display hints. will open PR with tests.

simon (SDK): I'll add tests for Node/Python/Go that stub 401 missing_scope vs 401 expired_token and assert different is_retryable semantics.

claire (DevEx): small Console request: show `code` + `hints` + `trace_id` in error inspector for easier triage.

tom (infra): low-effort, adding to backlog.

marie (PM): filing RFC for canonical codes and migration plan, linking PRs.

claire (DevEx): thanks team — follow-ups: SDK PRs, quickstart patch, docs update. let's avoid making quickstart guess intent from text. use structured fields. :thumbsup:
